decision.summary: The 9 Oct gas visit is marked satisfactory in Flintmere's job app, but no signed record has been issued. Flintmere's quality desk paused it over an appliance installation query, and the portal shows the document as "Processing". The tenant reports repeated boiler lockouts with no gas smell, and the landlord has not authorised a diagnostic. I escalated to compliance, asked the landlord for a yes/no on a diagnostic, chased Flintmere with a 21 Oct deadline, updated the tenant and set a follow-up.

answers.question: Where does this case stand and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The visit happened on 9 Oct and the job card is complete and satisfactory. The signed gas safety record has not been issued and is paused by Flintmere with no date. The portal screenshot is not a signed certificate. The previous record dated 16 Oct 2024 has reached its anniversary. The boiler lockouts are uninvestigated and the landlord has not approved a diagnostic. The tenant's copy is due by 6 Nov.

answers.question: What is the next action, for whom, and by which channel?
answers.answer: Three actions were taken. (1) Flintmere (Riva Morn) was chased by email for the query detail and a record date by 21 Oct. (2) The landlord was asked by request_landlord_approval for a yes/no on a diagnostic by 21 Oct. (3) The tenant was updated on the existing portal thread with safety advice.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Yes. The compliance team has escalation ESC-101 (P2). The gas record is outstanding with an unexplained installation-detail query that could be a safety matter, and the landlord has restricted spend. Whether to press Flintmere hard or use a second Gas Safe engineer needs authority.

conflicts: The portal record says Complete/Satisfactory but the customer document is Processing and Flintmere has paused the paperwork. I treated the record as not issued.
The tenant's 21 Oct offer is access for a possible future visit, not a booked appointment; 9 Oct was the original visit.
assumptions: The previous record anniversary falls on or about 16 Oct 2025.
The tenant's preferred channel is the portal; the message was sent on the existing thread.

args.body: Hi Iona, thanks for your updates. The item on file is only a portal screen showing the 9 October visit as complete and satisfactory; the signed gas safety record has not been issued yet because Flintmere is checking an appliance detail. We have asked them for the reason and a date by 21 October, and you must get your copy within 28 days of the visit (by 6 November). The boiler lockouts were not covered by that visit; we have asked your landlord whether a separate check can go ahead and will use your access after 21 October once agreed. Until then, if the boiler locks out, resetting it is fine, but please stop using it and ring 0800 111 999 straight away if you smell gas; if the lockouts continue, leave it off. Also make sure any carbon monoxide alarm works; if it sounds or anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea, leave, open windows and call 0800 111 999 (999 if unwell). We'll update you by 21 October.
